review_findings.exact_source_units: Nehemiah 3 contains 36 actual units, with 3:7 absent. Nehemiah 7:26 is one composite unit with Baithleem and Netopha; 7:73 includes both settlement and the seventh-month transition. Neither numbering nor boundaries were normalized.
review_findings.source_specific_wording: The unusual negative wall-work statement at 5:16 is preserved and deferred; 6:9 remains a declaration about strengthened hands. Neither omitted repetition counts nor expanded familiar sanctuary wording are imported.
review_findings.hired_crowd: The author correction is supported: 6:12 continues with a hired crowd in 6:13. Final pair 50 distinguishes the unsent prophecy, hired crowd and frightening prophets without asserting that the individual prophetic speaker was expressly hired.
review_findings.register_comparisons: Parallel register links preserve divergent names, ordering, totals, donor groups and units. The priestly and locality Eram entries remain distinct; individual identity and identical event claims are not added.
review_findings.unresolved_candidates: The four uncertain register identifications, sanctuary-law application and Pool of Fleeces/King's Pool identification remain unresolved with zero source and pair credit. The separately retained 3:15 link concerns the explicit steps of David's city.
review_findings.exact_history: The author stage contains exactly one category/rationale refinement and removal of a redundant narrow register edge; the full old rows, snapshots and final corrected triple are preserved and verified.
